scenarios.name: Dismiss tab overflow without changing the active ribbon

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full ribbon displayed
View is active but outside the visible tab row because the window is narrow
the user opens the ribbon tab overflow menu
the View command groups remain displayed
the user reopens the ribbon tab overflow menu
the user clicks the overflow control again
the overflow menu closes and the View command groups remain displayed
the user reopens the ribbon tab overflow menu
the user clicks the visible Tools tab
Tools becomes active and its command groups replace the View groups
